PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Authenticated player bankroll, active free spin vault state, and lifetime slot statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the player account menu.

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

balance.description: Current player credit balance in USD.

freeSpinsLeft.description: Remaining free spins in the current bonus round.

freeSpinPot.description: Accumulated bonus winnings waiting for end-of-bonus collection.

freeSpinsPlayed.description: Number of free spins played in the current bonus round.

totalSpins.description: Lifetime spins completed by the player.

biggestWin.description: Largest single spin or bonus round payout.

lastDailyBonusAt.description: Server timestamp of the last claimed 24-hour daily login bonus.

dailyBonusStreak.description: Consecutive daily login bonus streak count.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last player state sync.

/players/{userId}.description: Per-user private slot vault storing bankroll, active free spin pot state, and stats.
